trees.name: Red maple
trees.tell: Three main lobes (often two small ones at the base) with toothed edges and narrow V-shaped notches; leaf stalks, twigs and flowers are red.

trees.tell: Five lobes with a few big teeth and smooth edges between them, and rounded U-shaped notches; clear sap in the leaf stalk. A stylised sugar maple leaf is on Canada’s flag.
